note: state/tickets-snapshot/: merged-branches.tsv (the merged PR found for a branch-only ticket's ref and SHA), branch-commits.tsv (the commit actor and date for a SHA, which never change) and not-merged.tsv (the 'no merged PR for this ref' answer for a ref and SHA, valid until the SHA changes, the PR record gets a closed row for the head ref, or TICKETS_SNAPSHOT_NOT_MERGED_MAX_AGE_S). Each file is written tmp+mv and pruned by age and by the branch list (notmerged_gc). A failed or refused GitHub read writes no row. Losing the directory costs one closed-PR read and one commit read per branch-only ticket on the next tick. Machine-local, never carried
